steps.title: W1 CAD import
instructions: W1 CAD import: owner test pack T-W1. Import an NX .exp, a SolidWorks design table and a CSV. Re-import a changed file, and the dependent sheet goes stale.
- A comma-delimited CSV with a decimal comma must be refused unless its numbers are quoted.

steps.title: W2 scan import
instructions: W2 scan import: owner test pack T-W2. Load the Zeiss groove CSV and check the statistics. σ_within is c4-corrected; see the test values.

steps.title: W3 materials and licensed records
instructions: W3 materials and licensed records: T-W3 and T-REC. A record marked licensed never leaves in an export, in any revision.

steps.title: C-3 records screen and CSV import
instructions: C-3 records screen and CSV import: owner test pack section 5.5 (R20 to R30). A worksheet that lacks records (Conductor sizing) lists the required ones with a Fill link to Engineering → Modules → Calculations → Reference records. Import a record template (from docs/verification/record-templates/) filled from your own copy: a wrong unit, a bad row or a malformed file saves nothing; a good one saves the whole table, licensed by default, with the file's SHA-256 stamped. No button exports a record.

steps.title: Lifting 1: With the flag off, neither lifting worksheet is listed
instructions: With the flag off, neither lifting worksheet is listed. A saved lifting calculation refuses to open or run. The refusal names the admin setting.

steps.title: Lifting 2: Switch the flag on
instructions: Switch the flag on. Run PowerShell as administrator:
New-Item -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\TempestOS\Features' -Force | Out-Null
New-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\TempestOS\Features' -Name Lifting -PropertyType DWord -Value 1 -Force | Out-Null
Restart the app. Both lifting worksheets appear. The log records the source.

steps.title: Lifting 3: Run the struct.lifting test set from v0.26.0-test-values.md
instructions: Run the struct.lifting test set from v0.26.0-test-values.md.

steps.title: Lifting 4: Sign-off with four different people, using Switch person…
instructions: Sign-off with four different people, using Switch person…:
- one prepares it;
- a second attests;
- a third checks;
- a fourth countersigns. The statement must be 20 characters or more.
Each wrong person is refused. Any edit after the attestation voids it.

steps.title: Lifting 5: The issued sheet says
instructions: The issued sheet says:
- "design calculation, not a thorough examination";
- that signatures are not authenticated;
- "Optional feature: …".

steps.title: Lifting 6: Switch the flag off again
instructions: Switch the flag off again:
Remove-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Policies\TempestOS\Features' -Name Lifting
Do not use S8 for real lifts until you have recorded the BTH-1 / EN 13155 review (owner test pack, section 10) and signatures are authenticated.
